meta.title: Web Search Enhanced
meta.description: Choose how each session searches the web: keyless Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily, Tinyfish and OpenAlex, your own API keys, DeepSeek search, or the search tool of the session model.

en.activation.body: {services} work without a key, with shared limits. Choose a connection for each session from the globe button in the composer, and add keys or custom connections in the plugin settings.
en.activation.title: Web search is ready
en.command.description: Switch the search connection and freshness of this session
en.command.label: Search settings
en.command.readFailed: Couldn’t load search settings. Try again.
en.credential.failed: The key was not saved. Try again.
en.credential.hint: Stored in DSH Credentials under {ref}, never in settings.
en.credential.label: API key
en.credential.readOnly: {ref} comes from a source DSH cannot write, such as an environment variable.
en.custom.removeConfirm: Remove the custom connection “{name}”? Its credential is not deleted.
en.custom.title: Custom connections
en.defaults.connectionHint: For new sessions. If the session model was used with a connection before, that connection is used instead. When not set, the only ready connection is used, or search starts off.
en.defaults.freshnessHint: For new sessions. Only {services} honor it; other connections ignore it.
en.defaults.showSelectorHint: When hidden, switch the current session with /setup-search.
en.defaults.title: Defaults
en.draft.baseURL: Enter a full http(s) Base URL.
en.draft.credentialRef: A credential reference uses letters, digits and underscores and does not start with a digit.
en.draft.duplicate: This ID is already in use.
en.draft.id: The ID must start with custom: followed by letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens.
en.draft.label: Enter a name.
en.draft.trust: Confirm that you trust this endpoint.
en.editor.apiKeyHint: Saved to DSH Credentials under the reference above after the connection is saved.
en.editor.credentialRefHint: Name of a DSH credential, such as SEARCH_API_KEY. Not the key itself.
en.editor.endpointHint: Leave empty for the official endpoint.
en.editor.idHint: Letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens.
en.editor.keyFailed: The connection was saved, but its key was not. Set the key from the list.
en.editor.label: Name
en.editor.optionsHint: Leave a field empty for the default.
en.editor.stale: Settings changed after you opened this editor. Cancel and reopen it to avoid overwriting those changes.
en.editor.trust: I trust this endpoint and allow sending the credential {ref} to it.
en.editor.trustUnnamed: I trust this endpoint and allow sending this connection’s credential to it.
en.models.followHint: Searches with the server-side search tool of the session model.
en.models.limits: Works with API-key routes on Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions; OAuth and subscription routes are not supported.
en.models.optionsHint: Used when the session model speaks this protocol. Leave a field empty for the default.
en.models.title: Model search
en.options.hint: Saved as you change them. Leave a field empty for the service default.
en.options.keylessMore: More options are available with a personal key.
en.options.title: Request options
en.reset.confirm: Restore every search setting to its default?
en.reset.hint: Returns every search setting to its default and deletes custom connections. Saved keys are kept.
en.route.auto: The Profile’s web row names no searchProvider, so web_search picks among all usable providers and fails when there are several; nothing on this page takes effect. Set searchProvider: {id} on the web row and keep its fetchProvider.
en.route.deepseekApi: web_search is served by the DeepSeek Search API, a setting left by the switch on DSH’s built-in Web search page, so this page and each session’s search choice have no effect. Set searchProvider on the Profile’s web row back to {id}; the switch also set fetchProvider to deepseek-fetch-api, so change that back to http if needed.
en.route.other: web_search is served by the provider “{provider}”, not by this plugin ({id}), so this page and each session’s search choice have no effect. Set searchProvider: {id} on the Profile’s web row.
en.selector.freshnessHint.fresh: Prefers content cached within 24 hours. May be slower and use more quota.
en.selector.freshnessHint.realtime: Fetches pages again. Slower and uses more quota.
en.selector.readFailed: Couldn’t load search settings. Click to retry.
en.selector.readOnly: You cannot change search for this session.
en.services.accessHint.apiKey: Uses your API key and personal limits; request options are available.
en.services.accessHint.keyless: Uses the public endpoint and shared limits of the service; your key is never sent.
en.services.accountHint: Sessions signed in with a DeepSeek account search with that account. Other sessions use the API key below.
en.services.title: Search services
en.settings.failed: Not saved. Check the connection to DSH and try again.
en.settings.intro: Each session picks its own search connection, from the globe button in the composer or with /setup-search. This page sets the defaults for new sessions and how each connection signs in. Status dots reflect local configuration only, not quota or service health.
en.settings.migration: These settings still use the previous format. The plugin upgrades them when it starts; reopen this page afterwards.
en.settings.refused: Not saved. The settings may have changed elsewhere; check them and try again.
en.settings.unsupported: These settings were written by a newer plugin version or are malformed. Upgrade the plugin before editing them here.
en.status.missing: The selected connection no longer exists.
en.status.needsAccount: {name} needs a DeepSeek account sign-in or an API key.
en.write.conflict: Search was changed elsewhere. The menu now shows the current choice.
en.write.unavailable: That connection is turned off or was removed.
